data.title: Reliance Industries Limited - Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) All India Hiring 2027
data.details:
The Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) Program - 2027

The Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) Program - 2027 at Reliance aims to hand-pick young, high-potential engineering talent across India and nurture them to take on key technical roles across Reliance.

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Final-year engineering students from AICTE-Approved Colleges pursuing full-time B.Tech/B.E. Graduating in 2027 in Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Fire, Civil or Instrumentation streams.
  • Minimum 60% or 6 CGPA across 10th, 12th, and Diploma (if applicable), and a minimum aggregate of 6 CGPA / 60% or more in engineering (up to the latest semester).
  • No Active Backlogs and No Cases of Detention: Students who currently have active backlogs or have experienced academic detention are not eligible.
  • A candidate must not have a total of more than 3 years of education gap (between 10th and 12th, 12th and Diploma (if applicable), Diploma (if applicable) and B.Tech, 12th and B.Tech).
  • The candidate should not have applied to the RIL Graduate Engineer Trainee program in the last 6 months.
  • The candidate should not have interned with us as a part of the RIL Summer Internship program between May - August 2026.
  • The candidate should be a resident of India.

Here''s what you can expect:

  • The GET program provides a launch pad for budding engineers by giving them training and exposure through a 1-year structured learning journey.
  • Discover the exciting world of Reliance through a robust Onboarding and Orientation program.
  • Build Technical Capabilities through a structured Learning program (discipline-specific, cross-discipline and on-the-job).
  • Make your career shine by leveraging growth opportunities available for young calibre engineers.
  • The role may involve a combination of site-based and desk-based work.

Want to take a sneak peek into what a GET Life looks like? Click Here

Disclaimer:

  • Candidates should ensure that they fulfil the eligibility criteria before applying.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • Selected candidates may be placed at any location basis RIL''s requirements.
  • The offer provided to the candidate will be valid only on:
    • The candidate furnishing valid and original documents as per the eligibility criteria at any stage as requested by RIL. In case the furnished details are found to be fraudulent, RIL reserves the right to reject the candidate at any stage.
    • The candidate clearing the Pre-Employment Medical (PEM) examination that will be conducted before joining.
  • RIL''s decision at every stage of the process will be final and binding.

Website: www.ril.com

About Reliance Industries Limited:

Reliance Industries Limited (RIL) is India''s largest private sector company, with a consolidated revenue of INR 11,75,919 crore (US$ 124.0 billion), cash profit of INR 1,71,258 crore (US$ 18.1 billion) and net profit of INR 95,754 crore (US$ 10.1 billion) for the year ended March 31, 2026. Reliance''s activities span hydrocarbon exploration and production, petroleum refining and marketing, petrochemicals, advanced materials and composites, renewables (solar and hydrogen), retail, digital services and media and entertainment. Currently ranked 85th, Reliance is the largest private sector company from India to be featured on the Fortune Global 500® list of ''World''s Largest Companies'' for 2026. The company stands 55th in the Forbes Global 2000® rankings of ''World''s Largest Public Companies'' for 2026, the highest among Indian companies. Reliance has been recognized in the TIME100 list of the ''100 Most Influential Companies of 2024'', making it the only Indian company to have achieved this honour twice. Website: www.ril.com

Opportunities for GETs in Reliance span across the following areas:

 

Reliance is one of the few companies globally with integration from oil to transportation fuels, polymers and elastomers, intermediates, and polyesters. Its world-class refining and petrochemicals manufacturing assets are located at Jamnagar, Hazira, Dahej, Nagothane, Vadodara, Patalganga, Silvassa, Barabanki and Hoshiarpur. Click here to learn more.

 

Reliance Project Management Group (RPMG) is the in-house project management arm of Reliance for managing its capital investments. It executes large & complex green and brown field projects across multiple manufacturing sites. RPMG executes projects in a challenging environment through implementation of best project management and execution practices.

 

Reliance''s quest to secure India''s energy needs led to exploration and discovery of Oil & Gas fields in deep-sea waters. Discoveries in the KG D6 Block have bolstered India''s energy security, accelerated India''s transition towards a greener gas economy, and made Reliance a pioneer in oil and gas exploration and production. Click here to learn more.

 

P&C is an integrated material procurement, services contracting and material management function. It operates to procure quality products and services in the most cost-effective and time bound manner.

 

Reliance has committed to an ambitious target of achieving net-zero carbon status by 2035. The New Energy proposition is key to achieving this. Click here to learn more.

 

Reliance Bioenergy is committed to leading the way in sustainable energy solutions. Through innovative technology, dedication to environmental stewardship, and digital-first approach, Reliance is committed to providing reliable, sustainable energy solutions that benefit both the environment and the economy. Click here to learn more.

Reliance Real Estate: All the RIL projects are for catering mainly to the internal business requirements by using best construction techniques from time to time for fast-track execution comprising most optimum mix of conventional RCC works, Precast options, Pre-Engineered Building option. Further the amenities are provided with the high-end interior finishes and efficient MEP systems by selecting the best solution available to derive value for the investment, be it factory, office building, creating amenities for the exclusive use of the employees which include Guest houses, sports facilities, recreation areas, food and dining facilities, medical facilities with highly skilled doctors and with modern testing facilities etc.

data.title: Campus Hiring - GT Sales | 2027
data.details:
POLYCAB INDIA LIMITED

Graduate Trainee – Sales 

Aarambh 2027 

Polycab India Limited (PIL) is India’s largest manufacturer of Wires and Cables and one of the fastest growing FMEG companies with a consolidated turnover of ₹285+ Bn in FY26. PIL is at the forefront of providing innovative, safe and energy-efficient products to a diverse set of customers via a strong distribution network of 3,900+ authorized dealers and 190,000+ retail outlets. PIL’s business operations span across India through 26 manufacturing facilities, 15 offices and 35 warehouses. PIL has also served customers in 94 countries globally. PIL’s 4,500+ employees are dedicated to upholding robust governance practices, preserving a customer-centric culture, having a purpose to serve the communities, and imbibing a genuine sense of ecological consciousness.

For further information, please visit www.polycab.com

An important note for engineering students: this is a sales role, not a technical or core engineering role. Your engineering background is genuinely useful here — you will discuss specifications with electricians, contractors and consultants — but the job itself is commercial and customer-facing. Please apply only if you want to build a career in sales.

Role brief

This is a field sales role. You will spend most of your working day in the market, not in an office, and you will start in a Tier 3 town or city rather than a metro.

  • You will be in the market on roughly 20 to 25 days a month, visiting dealers, distributors and retail outlets.
  • A typical day starts in the market by mid-morning and involves visiting 12 to 20 outlets on a fixed beat plan, mostly on a two-wheeler and on foot.
  • You will be placed in a Tier 3 town or city where we have business — not a metro, and not necessarily your home state. This holds for your initial period. Larger territories in Tier 2 cities come later, for those identified as high potential.
  • Saturdays are working days. Market holidays vary by region.
  • You will not be designing, testing or working in a plant. If that is what you want, look at our Graduate Engineer Trainee programme in manufacturing instead.

If that sounds like the kind of work you want, read on. If it does not, this is not the right role for you — and that is a perfectly reasonable conclusion to reach.

Your first six months: Click Here

Eligibility

  • 2027 batch B.E. / B.Tech (Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical or Instrumentation), with no active backlogs
  • Minimum 60% in 10th, 12th and graduation
  • Willing to build a career in sales rather than in a core engineering or technical function

What we look for

  • Genuine interest in the technical side of the product — you will need to hold your own with an electrician, a contractor or a consultant
  • Patience and persistence. Demand creation does not pay off immediately.
  • The ability to build trust with people whose background is very different from your own
  • Willingness to travel and to relocate.

Who this role suits

  • You want your engineering knowledge to be useful in a commercial role
  • You are good at building relationships and willing to invest time in them
  • You want to understand how large infrastructure and industrial projects come together

Who it does not suit

  • You want to work in design, R&D, production or plant operations
  • You want quick wins and short cycles
  • You dislike site environments, or are uncomfortable working closely with electricians and contractors on the ground

Where this leads (B2B)

Market Development Manager → Territory Sales Manager → Area Sales Manager → Regional Sales Manager → National Sales Manager. Movement is based on performance.

Where this leads (B2C)

Territory Sales In-charge → Territory Sales Manager → Area Sales Manager → Regional Sales Manager → National Sales Manager. Movement is based on performance.

Post-Confirmation Compensation

  • Post-confirmation CTC, for Sales roles - INR 6,30,000 as Fixed pay + 20% Incentive
  • Post-confirmation CTC, for non-Sales roles - INR 6,30,000 as Fixed pay + 5% Performance pay

data.title: Campus Hiring  - PGT Sales | 2027
data.details:
POLYCAB INDIA LIMITED

Post Graduate Trainee – Sales (B2C)

Aarambh 2027 | B2C - Wires, Switchgears, Switches, Fans and Lighting 

Polycab India Limited (PIL) is India’s largest manufacturer of Wires and Cables and one of the fastest growing FMEG companies with a consolidated turnover of ₹285+ Bn in FY26. PIL is at the forefront of providing innovative, safe and energy-efficient products to a diverse set of customers via a strong distribution network of 3,900+ authorized dealers and 190,000+ retail outlets. PIL’s business operations span across India through 26 manufacturing facilities, 15 offices and 35 warehouses. PIL has also served customers in 94 countries globally. PIL’s 4,500+ employees are dedicated to upholding robust governance practices, preserving a customer-centric culture, having a purpose to serve the communities, and imbibing a genuine sense of ecological consciousness.

For further information, please visit www.polycab.com

Role brief

This is a field sales role. You will spend most of your working day in the market, not in an office, and you will start in a Tier 3 town or city rather than a metro.

  • You will be in the market on roughly 20 to 25 days a month, visiting dealers, distributors and retail outlets.
  • A typical day starts in the market by mid-morning and involves visiting 12 to 20 outlets on a fixed beat plan, mostly on a two-wheeler and on foot.
  • You will be placed in a Tier 3 town or city where we have business — not a metro, and not necessarily your home state. This holds for your initial period. Larger territories in Tier 2 cities come later, for those identified as high potential.
  • Saturdays are working days. Market holidays vary by region and may not match a standard weekend.
  • This is not a desk role, a marketing role or an analytics role. Reporting and system entries are part of the job, but they happen around market working, not instead of it.

If that sounds like the kind of work you want, read on. If it does not, this is not the right role for you — and that is a perfectly reasonable conclusion to reach.

Your first six months: Click Here

There are structured check-ins through this period with your mentor and business head, so you always know where you stand. Confirmation follows at six months, based on your progress.

After confirmation - Territory Sales In-charge

You own a set of outlets in a Tier 3 market. Broadly, that means:

  • Delivering secondary sales for your outlets, and growing the retailer base
  • Managing dealer and distributor relationships, including stock, claims and collections
  • Expanding reach — adding outlets, improving counter share, placing new products
  • Executing schemes and promotions, and tracking what they deliver
  • Reading your market — competition activity, pricing movement, demand shifts — and reporting it back

Eligibility

  • 2027 batch MBA (Marketing, Sales or related), with no active backlogs
  • B.E. / B. Tech (Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation) alongside the MBA 
  • Minimum 60% in 10th, 12th and graduation

What we look for

  • Comfort with people, you will spend your day in conversation with dealers, retailers and customers
  • Resilience. Some days you will hear no more often than yes.
  • Willingness to travel and to relocate
  • Self-direction. Nobody is watching you in the market; you set your own pace.

Who this role suits

  • You want to learn how a business actually makes money, at the point where it happens
  • You are energised by being out and about rather than at a desk
  • You want a clear, performance-linked path into sales leadership

Who it does not suit

  • You are looking for a corporate or head-office role
  • You want predictable hours in a fixed location
  • You would prefer a strategy, marketing or analytics profile

Where this leads

Territory Sales In-charge → Territory Sales Manager → Area Sales Manager → Regional Sales Manager → National Sales Manager. Movement is based on performance.

Post-Confirmation Compensation

  • Post-confirmation CTC, for Sales roles - INR 7,35,000 as Fixed pay + 20% Incentive
  • Post-confirmation CTC, for non-Sales roles - INR 7,35,000 as Fixed pay + 10% Performance pay
